name: AI Lion Friend: A Lion Walks Up to You on a Night Road
blurb: The AI lion trend is a night clip filmed through a car windshield: you stand on an empty road beside an open car door, a big male lion walks out of the dark toward you, and instead of attacking, it greets you like an old friend while you stroke its mane.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=ai-lion-friend-video) and add your photo (your photo). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the person's face, facial features, skin tone, hair, age, body shape and clothes exactly the same as in the photo. Dashcam-style night footage: one frame of a real phone video filmed through the windshield of a car stopped on an empty two-lane country road at night, with the dark dashboard and the hood across the bottom of the frame. A few meters ahead, a plain light-colored car is stopped on the road with its red rear lights on and its door open. The person has just stepped out of that car and stands on the road beside the open door, full body in view, lit by our headlights, calm and relaxed, looking down the road. Farther down the road, at the edge of the headlight beam, a big adult male lion with a thick golden mane walks slowly out of the dark toward the person, calm, with its head low. Dark trees and tall grass on both sides of the road, a black sky, warm headlight glow and a light haze. Photorealistic, grainy low-light phone footage, not CGI, not a cartoon. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one person and one lion. No other people or animals, no readable license plates, no car badges, no text, no logos.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Kling 3.0, 10 s, 1080p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: Dashcam-style night footage in one continuous shot, filmed through the windshield of a stopped car like a real phone video. Keep the person's face, hair and clothes and the lion exactly as in the image. The big male lion walks calmly out of the dark along the road toward the person, slow and relaxed, with its head low and its tail swinging gently. The person is not afraid: they smile and hold out a hand, like greeting an old friend. The lion stops right beside them and gently rubs its huge head and mane against their hand and side, like a friendly house cat. The person strokes its mane, scratches behind its ears and laughs softly, and the lion closes its eyes and leans into them, calm and happy. The lion stays calm and gentle the whole time: no roaring, no jumping up, no biting, no claws, no bared teeth. The camera stays still behind the windshield with a slight handheld sway, and the hood stays at the bottom of the frame. Audio: a quiet engine idle, crickets, the lion's soft low rumble and the person's soft laugh, and nothing else: no music, no dialogue. Exactly one person and one lion. No cuts, no extra people or animals, no extra limbs, no morphing, no text, no logos.
